fields.Name: AIUsageErrorRateByModel
fields.UserQuestion: What is the error rate and failure frequency for each AI model and vendor?
fields.Description: Per vendor and model: succeeded, failed and abandoned model calls and the resulting error rate, with cancelled and in-flight runs reported separately.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Classifies each non-parent prompt run (no CompletedAt requirement) as Cancelled, InFlight (Pending/Running, started within the last hour), Abandoned (Pending/Running, older than an hour), Failed (Success = 0) or Succeeded, then aggregates by VendorID and ModelID. ErrorRatePct = (Failed + Abandoned) / (Succeeded + Failed + Abandoned). Optional start/end filter the base RunAt column.
